title: SOMA sign-in: Google branding
_note: Project TestingTheCloud, Google account authuser=3. App name was Playmaker. Run after the JavaScript-origins Save, which adds most authorized domains; somastudios.ai is added here in case it is missing. No logo: uploading one sends the app to Google's brand verification.

steps.instruction: Yeshie set App name to SOMA (it was Playmaker) and Application home page to https://somastudios.ai. Every SOMA app's Google sign-in uses this name. If somastudios.ai is not under Authorized domains, click Add domain and type somastudios.ai. Then click Save.
